headline: Stifel Cuts Floor & Decor Rating on Weak Sales Outlook
summary: Stifel has cut its stock rating for Floor & Decor due to a weak sales outlook.

impacts.name: Floor & Decor Holdings
impacts.why: Downgrades citing weak sales outlook can lead to downward revisions in institutional equity holdings.

why_moved: Lowered sales projections highlighted by analysts dampen investor expectations for future revenue growth, pressuring the stock price.
